nodes.description: msg.sender is used as the deployer identity assigned to the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor.
msg.sender is used as the balance holder / allowance granter in transfer and approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
msg.sender is compared against newOwner before ownership is accepted.
Owned constructor; assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Accepts ownership when msg.sender == newOwner and moves newOwner into owner.
onlyOwner modifier; requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
B333Token constructor; sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the initial balance of the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender address, creating a callback into an untrusted contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
Owner-only function that performs an external ERC20 transfer call sending arbitrary tokens to the owner.
Addition with an overflow check performed after the arithmetic operation.
Subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
Multiplication with a post-check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division guarded by require(b > 0).
External callback function declared by the callback interface, invoked by approveAndCall on a caller-supplied address.
Public owner address controlling privileged functions.
Public pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string (B333).
Token name string (Bitcoin 333).
Token decimals (18).
Total token supply state variable.
Mapping address => uint holding token balances.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint holding allowances.
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with a caller-controlled address, enabling reentrancy / callback into arbitrary code.
External call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer on an owner-supplied arbitrary token contract.
Unchecked addition c = a + b executed before the require(c >= a) comparison.
Subtraction c = a - b executed after require(b <= a).
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b executed before the require check.
Division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable inside the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
msg.sender is the value compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership, restricting it to owner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token, restricting it to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before ownership is transferred.
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller and to emit OwnershipTransferred.
acceptOwnership moves newOwner into the owner state variable, then resets newOwner to address(0).
B333Token constructor sets the symbol state variable.
B333Token constructor sets the name state variable.
B333Token constructor sets the decimals state variable.
B333Token constructor sets _totalSupply to 333000000000000000000.
B333Token constructor assigns the whole supply into balances of the fixed deployer address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the returned supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the supplied tokenOwner.
msg.sender is used as the key into balances when debiting the transfer sender.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key when writing allowed in approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key into allowed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval callback.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer calls safeSub to debit balances[msg.sender].
transfer calls safeAdd to credit balances[to].
approve writes the nested allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for both from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice for the balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
approveAndCall performs an external call to a caller-supplied contract while state is already updated, exposing a reentrancy/callback vector.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract, transferring control to untrusted code.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an owner-supplied token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token passes the owner state variable as the recipient of the external token transfer.
safeAdd performs the addition c = a + b, checked only afterwards by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs the subtraction c = a - b after require(b <= a).
safeMul performs the multiplication c = a * b, checked only afterwards.
safeDiv performs the division c = a / b guarded only by require(b > 0).
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
'to' parameter receives the credited balance in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transfer.
spender parameter is granted the allowance in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance amount stored in approve.
'from' parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
'to' parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
spender parameter is both the allowance grantee and the external callback target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the allowance amount set in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval callback.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable in transferOwnership.
tokenAddress parameter is the target contract of the external transfer call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external token contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenOwner parameter is only a local binding used to index balances and has no independent security semantics.
The tokenOwner parameter is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping inside allowance.
The recipient parameter is consumed directly by the transfer balance update.
The tokens parameter is the amount fed into safeSub and safeAdd inside transfer.
The spender parameter is stored directly into allowed[msg.sender] without further logic.
The tokens parameter is written directly into the allowed mapping.
The from parameter only selects the debited account in transferFrom.
The to parameter only selects the credited account in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount passed to safeSub and safeAdd in transferFrom.
The spender parameter becomes the target contract of the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter is stored into the allowed mapping and forwarded to the callback.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
The _newOwner parameter is assigned directly to the newOwner state variable.
The tokenAddress parameter is the target of the unsafe external ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the unsafe external ERC20 transfer call.
